packageRules.description: In-repo libraries must hold the same version in every module. ci.yml does not check that; a split is only visible as a build failure somewhere else, so keep each bump to a single PR that moves all nine go.mod files together rather than nine PRs that land at nine different times. Everything else in Go is left to the default of one PR per dependency, which is the cadence the per-service dependabot configs used before the consolidation dropped them.
Actions as one grouped PR, as the per-service dependabot configs did.

Images the stack pulls rather than builds. Pinning them by digest is the point of this config: without it a CI result is a function of the registry as well as the commit, so an old commit re-run later can go red with nothing to bisect. The tag is kept alongside the digest so the file still says what it is running.

customManagers.description: Images named from Go rather than from compose: testcontainers constants in four services' testutil packages, and the piri compose generator, whose output is gitignored and so has no file for the docker-compose manager to read. The match REQUIRES an @sha256 digest, which fences this manager by construction: it sees exactly the references this repository has already pinned, and cannot touch the six ghcr.io/fil-forge/<service>:main entries in smelt/pkg/stack/options.go. Those are the published peers an itest run is meant to be tested against, and pinning them would turn that compatibility check into a slower copy of e2e.
